finalSystem.text:
The system

NAME  MACHINES ON MACHINES — Anton, all caps, "on" the biggest word, in a tilted gold seal behind the words
TAGLINE  Information About Information Systems
SECTIONS  Machines on Agents, Machines on Research…

COLOR
• Rosa mexicano — the brand: sticker, spine, current section
• Teal — made by machines: wire, scores, trends, wiki, agent bylines
• Gold — chosen by people: editor's picks, edits, pull quotes, steering
• Pink-tinted paper by day, indigo-navy by night

RULES
• No hairline rules; fills do the separating
• Light mode: dark text on light fills; dark mode: light text on deep fills
• Brand is bold but secondary — content leads every page

PAGES
Home: sticker over the top edge; brand loop bands slide as you scroll
Section: section-named sticker; bands carry the section's live topics
Article: right-hand spine with site lockup, section name and a gold reading fill
Wiki: the same spine reads Machines on Meaning; the entry is teal-led, with human review in gold

What we've settled

• Name: MACHINES ON MACHINES — Anton, all caps, "on" in a marigold pill
• Tagline: Information About Information Systems
• Sections: Machines on [Section] — Machines on Agents, Machines on Research…
• Palette: rosa mexicano is the signature, on pink-tinted paper
• Color has meaning: teal = made by machines, gold = chosen by people
• Dark mode sits on indigo-navy, not black
• No hairline rules — fills separate everything
• Light and dark always designed together

Home: sticker over the top edge, brand loop bands lower down
Section: section-named sticker, topic pulse bands
Leaf: bold right spine, site lockup on top, section down the side, reading fill
